label: bluegecko-2v1-great-divide
people: thebluegecko (the ledger's 'bluegecko'; OS 48 in the ranked duel list per docs/briefs/lessons.md), the north box, Armada; the header recorded no person (the shim bug of the time); bot.log names him 'player 0' for both of his chat lines
our_side: Two seats of ours in the south box, one player over both: seat 0 Armada at B8 (640, 3744), seat 1 Cortex at H8 (2691, 3690). The player was claude-opus-5 at effort medium (run/human_game.sh set no model), with no commander role. The hands were Jev jev-1.13.0 as the pianist (the one-pass era, before the hands rebuild). Realtime, in the user's lobby.
summary: thebluegecko walked his commander through the E5 pass at 4:26 with a Rocko and a Warrior, added a Lazarus by 5:57, and lived in our half (C7-D7) to the end, building a forward nest there from 8:02 (light turrets, then Beamers and a heavy turret at 12:07-12:27). Our two seats met his party one group at a time and lost nearly every fight with more metal on the spot, except at 8:03-9:13 (lost 1,694, killed 1,975); after that the west group flipped thirty times between a station under his turrets and home. Under all of it was a seat fault fixed the same day: the first turn saw one seat, and one name space for two seats sent the lists and standing orders to whichever seat ticked first. So no list step played before 3:00, no scout was ever made, and the never list and the stations landed on the wrong seat. He came west at 13:25 with Warriors, then a Fatboy (seen 14:14) and Zeus (14:38); the west commander died at 14:20, the east at 15:28. We lost 25.5k and saw 4.4k of his die.

root.what: The first turn fired at frame 1 with one seat published. The player took itself for the south-east Cortex seat alone and wrote one Cortex opening keyed 'commander', which both seats share. No list step played on either seat before 3:00: both plants defaulted to bot labs, the scout cars were never made, and his base was never seen. The same drain later split the standing orders across seats. The cost began at 4:26, when his commander walked into groups that met it one at a time.

their_play: This was a commander-led push, not a pass camp. His commander came through the E5 pass at 4:26 with a Rocko and a Warrior, and a Lazarus (seen 5:57) raised our wrecks. The commander stayed in our half every minute from 5:12 to 15:26 (sightings at z 3000-3500) and was never below 69%. From 8:02 he built a forward nest at D6-D7: an LLT, two more at 9:13, a Beamer at 12:07, then a heavy turret and a second Beamer at 12:27. Warriors were the body, with a reserve of 12-20 radar contacts at D3-E4 that we never identified. Only two LLTs stood at the pass's north mouth (7:05, 7:07). His tier 2 was ready by about 14:00: a Fatboy seen at B8 at 14:14 and Zeus at 14:38, for the final sweep west (13:25-14:20) and then east (14:42-15:28). At 1:12 he told our player not to announce its faction and spawn.

defects.defect: Two seats shared one name space, and the first turn fired at frame 1 with one seat published (K-team-one-name-for-two-seats-loses-a-seat). Lists and standing orders went to whichever seat ticked first: the Cortex list to the Armada seat, the never list to seat 0 only, the stations to the other seat. A precursor of eras group B. The loss rests largely on it.

bears_on.note: This lesson comes from this game: at 0:48 our player said 'south-east seat here, Cortex', and thebluegecko answered at 1:12. Whether the announcement helped his commander push is not shown.
His commander stood in our half for 11 minutes with one to three escorts. Our groups never circled it: its lowest health was 69% at 7:29, and 'every soldier onto their commander' landed 53 s late.
The two seats' groups met the commander party one at a time (west 4:38, east 5:30). The player's note at 7:18: 'only half our soldiers are ever in the fight'.
Nothing of ours pressed his side. The first Pawn turned back at 4:17 and his base was never seen, so his commander was free to walk south at 4:26.
Four metal makers at 3:14-3:55 on a store near 0. The lesson's premise ('a metal heavy map') is Comet's and is unmeasured for Great Divide.
Labs idled behind their own commander, constructors and an extractor in the exit lanes (8:50, 12:42).

bears_on.id: Great Divide: the pass, the camp, fire over it, air, the crossing
bears_on.note: No camp at the pass: two LLTs at its north mouth (7:05). He walked his commander through at 4:26 and built his nest in our half (D6-D7) from 8:02. The 'one covered point at the mouth' was never ours (spot_11 never taken).

bears_on.id: The commander's conduct: fights at home, builds at the plant, never toward what outreaches it, the early army
bears_on.note: An OS-48 person used his commander as the early army in our half for 11 minutes, and it lived. Ours helped the lab about 700 from it and never fought; the west one died at 14:20 after a retreat that landed 47 s late.

bears_on.id: Going and the lead: a lead decays, one body from a gathering place, arrive together, the ball's return home, only the army wins
bears_on.note: The groups arrived piecemeal and the ball kept returning home (flips 9:36-12:01). Our combined army was 2.3-2.6x his seen army in minutes 6-10, but that count is a floor and leaves out his commander.

bears_on.id: Reach, turret lines and nests, the odds model (a turret at three times its metal), unseen fire, scouting before committing
bears_on.note: The army was parked under an LLT/Beamer nest at C7-D7 (seat 0 #4-#6: -2,910 for 540). The player's counter at 10:12 was Rocketeers (475) to outrange the LLTs (430).

bears_on.id: Pressure from the first units: the first handful crosses the map
bears_on.note: No first handful crossed, so the initiative and the ground of the fights were his from 4:26.

bears_on.id: Expansion and income: constructors by the clock, the midline, mohos and advanced solars, the late ladder
bears_on.note: Ten of the south's eleven spots taken by 4:54 (the map's ceiling), then no nano, second plant or moho; income fell 15.0 to 8.4 on the west seat.

bears_on.id: The tier-2 sprint: trigger, conduct, feeding, the team procedure, tier 1 against tier 2 and 3
bears_on.note: The brief's 'tier 2 by about 10:00 on both seats' was never attempted. His Fatboy (seen 14:14) and Zeus (14:38) closed the game.

lens.caveats: No truth file, no results.jsonl and no batch.json: his numbers are floors, and 12-20 contacts were never priced. minutes.py, analyze_match, floor and raid_ledger read only record-0; seat 1 was read through a scratchpad directory of symlinks. pro_baseline was not run (Comet only). chat.jsonl marks all three lines '?', but bot.log gives 'player 0' (the north seat, the opponent) for 'gl hf' and the 1:12 line; the 0:48 line is our player's say. Where I differ from review.md: (1) it ranks by cost, this row by root. (2) The 30 flips and the banned-spot walks were the seat drain, per the claim and the Jev slots, not 'a station set that does not replace an advance' or 'never not pruning the gate'. (3) His Fatboy was first seen at 14:14, not 15:00. (4) Our combined army was 2.3-2.6x his seen army in minutes 6-10, against its 'never 2x'. (5) The player's '3670 destroyed' was the double count. The rest of the review's findings stand.

open_questions: How big were his economy and army (no truth file; 12-20 contacts at D3-E4 never identified)? Was our 2.3-2.6x of the seen army in minutes 6-10 real?
Would both groups and both commanders converged at 4:30-5:30 have killed his commander (3,700 hp and a D-gun, with 1-3 escorts)? The lowest we saw was 2,567 at 7:29.

The backlog's episode index (backlog.md section c, group X 'the old heuristic bot') lists this game, but it was a pianist game (Opus 5 over Jev 1.13). The tag is an over-tag through a passage citing team-2v2 games, and its row 809 note should not be read as this game's regime.

Seat 0's group_A held under shelling at 4:26-4:38 ('leaves party_4 and holds [rule]' while hit) before any fall-back. Was that the rule's hold beside a party with a commander? No eras-list entry names it.
When did his advanced lab start? It was never seen; the Fatboy at 14:14 bounds it.
